SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Admin
Represents an Admin user in the system.
AdminDAO
AdminDAO is a Data Access Object interface for performing operations related to Admin entities such as adding a new admin and retrieving all existing admins from the data source.
AdminDAOImplementation
AdminDAOImplementation provides an in-memory implementation of the AdminDAO interface for managing Admin entities.
Book
Represents a book with a title, author, count, and availability status.
BookDAO
BookDAO is a Data Access Object interface for managing operations related to Book entities such as adding, removing, retrieving, and saving books.
BookDAOImplementation
BookDAOImplementation provides an in-memory and file-based implementation of the BookDAO interface.
InvalidLoanException
Exception thrown when an invalid loan operation occurs in the library system.
Librarian
Represents a Librarian user in the system.
LibrarianDAO
LibrarianDAO is a Data Access Object interface for managing operations related to Librarian entities, such as adding a new librarian and retrieving all librarians from the data source.
LibrarianDAOImplementation
LibrarianDAOImplementation provides an in-memory implementation of the LibrarianDAO interface for managing librarian data.
LibrarySystem
Service class representing the core library system operations.
LibrarySystemTest
Unit tests for LibrarySystem, validating its core functionality such as: adding books, managing users (members invalid input: '&' librarians), issuing and returning books, and retrieving system records.
Loan
Represents a loan of a book to a member.
LoanDAO
LoanDAO is a Data Access Object interface for handling operations related to Loan entities.
LoanDAOImplementation
LoanDAOImplementation provides an in-memory and file-based implementation of the LoanDAO interface.
Main
Main entry point for the Library Management System.
Member
Represents a Member user in the system.
MemberDAO
MemberDAO is a Data Access Object interface for managing operations related to Member entities, such as adding a member, finding a member by ID, and retrieving all members.
MemberDAOImplementation
MemberDAOImplementation provides an in-memory implementation of the MemberDAO interface for managing member data.
RoleCheck
Custom annotation to specify the required role for accessing or performing actions on the annotated class.
User
Abstract base class representing a user in the system.
UserDAO
UserDAO is a Data Access Object interface that defines operations for managing User entities, including adding a new user and retrieving all users from the data source.
UserDAOImplementation
Implementation of the UserDAO interface for managing User entities in-memory.
ValidationUtility
Utility class for validating input strings such as names, emails, book titles, and authors.
